title: OptraSight Tooling Integrations Catalog
description: Canonical machine-readable spec describing every open-source tool integrated by the OptraSight multi-tenant brand abuse & attack-surface platform. Each entry declares: how to invoke the tool (CLI binary, HTTP API, or library), its container image, env vars / API keys, input contract, output contract, the platform layer it belongs to, and the internal platform endpoint that consumes it.

platform.name: OptraSight
platform.changelog: v2: added DorkScan, TinEye, FOFA, KELA, SecurityTrails, VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB. Added per-tenant integration management + multi-tenant report generation.

conventions.scheduling: All long-running scans dispatched through Celery; default queues: discovery, brand_abuse, active_scan, intel.
conventions.tenancy: Every tool invocation is wrapped by an adapter that injects tenant_id, scope_targets, and writes results to the tenant-scoped Postgres schema and S3 prefix.
conventions.secrets: API keys are pulled from the platform secrets store at adapter init; never baked into images.

integrations.name: DNSTwist
integrations.purpose: Generate domain permutations (typosquats, homoglyphs, bitsquats, IDN homographs) and detect lookalikes via DNS lookups + fuzzy/perceptual hashes.

integrations.name: openSquat
integrations.purpose: Daily scan of newly registered domain feeds (WHOIS, CT logs) for brand impersonation.

integrations.name: phishing_catcher (CertStream)
integrations.purpose: Stream Certificate Transparency logs in real-time and score domains against per-tenant keyword rules to surface phishing infrastructure as it appears.

input_schema.description: Per-tenant scoring rules pulled from DB on container start

integrations.name: DomScan
integrations.purpose: Domain intelligence API for availability, WHOIS, DNS health, brand monitoring, and suspicious domain discovery.

env.name: DOMSCAN_API_KEY
env.description: DomScan API key; store per tenant in Integrations.

integrations.name: crt.sh (Certificate Transparency)
integrations.purpose: Query public Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh) for newly-issued certificates matching a brand keyword. No API key required; runs over public HTTPS.

integrations.name: WHOIS Enrichment
integrations.purpose: System whois binary used to enrich each Malicious Site Scanner candidate with registrar, creation date, expiry, and registrant country. Disable to skip WHOIS lookups (faster scans, no age signal).

integrations.name: Keyword Expansion (14-Technique)
integrations.purpose: Pure-math typosquat/homoglyph/combosquat generator from the SOP §6 methodology. Variants are DNS-verified before joining the candidate set. Disable to skip the heuristic expansion (faster scans, fewer candidates).

integrations.name: URLScan.io
integrations.purpose: Submit suspicious URLs and retrieve full screenshot, DOM, HTTP transactions, certificates, and brand-detection verdict.

integrations.name: OWASP Amass
integrations.purpose: In-depth attack surface mapping & subdomain enumeration via OSINT + active recon.

env.name: AMASS_CONFIG
env.description: Path to amass config.ini with API keys

integrations.name: Subfinder
integrations.purpose: Fast passive subdomain enumeration from 30+ public sources.

integrations.name: theHarvester
integrations.purpose: Collect emails, employee names, subdomains, hosts, and ports from search engines and breach sources.

integrations.name: SpiderFoot
integrations.purpose: OSINT automation hub with 200+ modules; runs as a long-lived service exposing a REST API.

integrations.name: Shodan
integrations.purpose: Passive internet-wide service intelligence; query exposed services for tenant IP ranges and brand strings.

integrations.name: Censys
integrations.purpose: Passive scan of all 65k ports across the IPv4 space; deeper service visibility than Shodan.

integrations.name: Nuclei
integrations.purpose: Template-based vulnerability scanner; runs 8000+ YAML templates against tenant assets.

integrations.name: Nmap
integrations.purpose: Port scanning and service/version fingerprinting.

integrations.name: Masscan
integrations.purpose: Internet-scale TCP port scanner; pre-stage to Nmap for large IP ranges.

integrations.name: EyeWitness
integrations.purpose: Bulk web-service screenshots + header capture for visual triage.

integrations.name: Wappalyzer (wappalyzergo)
integrations.purpose: Identify technology stack of any URL; used to enrich assets and to fingerprint phishing kits on lookalike sites.

integrations.name: DorkScan
integrations.purpose: Automated Google/Bing dorking to surface exposed credentials, sensitive files, exposed admin panels, leaked source, and brand-impersonating sites indexed by search engines.

env.name: GOOGLE_CSE_KEY
env.description: Google Custom Search API key (avoids rate limiting)

integrations.name: TinEye
integrations.purpose: Reverse image search across the public web to detect unauthorized use, redistribution, or impersonation of brand logos, executive headshots, marketing creative, and product imagery.

endpoints.purpose: reverse image search by URL or upload

integrations.name: FOFA
integrations.purpose: Cyberspace asset search engine (Chinese: 网络空间测绘) — pivot on cert subjects, favicon hashes, response banners, and ASN to find exposed brand-related infrastructure that DNS scans miss.

integrations.name: KELA Threat Intelligence
integrations.purpose: Dark-web and cybercrime underground monitoring — surfaces leaked credentials, network access for sale, mentions of the brand on initial-access broker forums, and ransomware victim disclosures.

integrations.name: SecurityTrails
integrations.purpose: Historical DNS and WHOIS intelligence — passive DNS, subdomain enumeration, IP neighbors, and full WHOIS history. Great for surfacing forgotten/legacy infrastructure tied to a brand.

integrations.name: VirusTotal
integrations.purpose: Reputation and detonation: query AV verdicts on suspect domains/URLs/IPs, fetch passive DNS, sibling subdomains, and downloaded payloads observed by 70+ engines.

submit.description: submit for fresh scan if URL

integrations.name: AbuseIPDB
integrations.purpose: IP reputation database with crowd-sourced abuse reports — confidence score, abuse categories (DDoS, brute force, scanning, malware C2), reporter geo, last reported. Used to enrich every IP discovered by FOFA/Shodan/Censys/SecurityTrails.

endpoints.purpose: reputation lookup for a single IP

integrations.name: Splunk Enterprise / Cloud
integrations.purpose: Push OptraSight detection rules (SPL) into Splunk as saved searches / correlation searches.

env.name: API_TOKEN
env.description: Splunk auth token with rights to create saved searches

integrations.name: Elastic Security (ELK / Kibana)
integrations.purpose: Push OptraSight detection rules (KQL / EQL) into Elastic Security as detection rules.

env.name: API_TOKEN
env.description: Kibana API key with detection-rule write scope

integrations.name: Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR (KQL)
integrations.purpose: Push OptraSight detection rules (KQL) into Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules or Defender XDR custom detections.

env.name: API_TOKEN
env.description: Azure AD bearer token with SecurityInsights.ReadWrite scope

integrations.name: CrowdStrike Falcon (Custom IOA / FQL)
integrations.purpose: Push OptraSight detection rules into CrowdStrike Falcon as custom IOAs / scheduled FQL queries.

integrations.name: Palo Alto Cortex XDR / XSIAM (XQL)
integrations.purpose: Push OptraSight detection rules (XQL) into Cortex XDR / XSIAM as correlation rules.

integrations.name: SentinelOne Singularity (PowerQuery / S1QL)
integrations.purpose: Push OptraSight detection rules into SentinelOne as custom STAR rules / scheduled queries.

env.name: API_TOKEN
env.description: S1 API token with rule-write scope

integrations.name: Google SecOps / Chronicle (YARA-L)
integrations.purpose: Push OptraSight detection rules (YARA-L 2.0) into Google SecOps / Chronicle as detection rules.

env.name: API_TOKEN
env.description: GCP service-account bearer token with chronicle.rules.write scope
